title: my work in progress. Built with opus 5.5. it's a Tank / Mecha Battle royale. Please give feedbacks on it's visual and gameplay.
author: Fluffy-Discussion166
selftext: do the tanks and mech look too small and  low poly? how can I make the mech look cooler when It swing it's sword?

replies.body: tanks! Will explore more effects with claude

comments.author: Silver-Second-647
comments.body:
https://reddit.com/link/phd1h20/video/whwomwjax2wh1/player

This looks really cool!! I love the idea of a tank and mecha battle royale!

I thought some extra sound effects could make the mechs feel heavier and the combat more impactful, especially those sword attacks!

So I tried adding some sounds to a short section of your gameplay. Hope you like it!

replies.author: Fluffy-Discussion166
replies.body: thanks 🫡 where you get those sounds ?

replies.author: Silver-Second-647
replies.body: I made them using my own AI tool! It generates sound effects directly from gameplay videos (⁠ ⁠ꈍ⁠ᴗ⁠ꈍ⁠)

replies.author: Fluffy-Discussion166
replies.body: that's cool dude. still in development ?

replies.author: Silver-Second-647
replies.body:
Yep! It's called CICA Audio, and it's currently in closed beta!

I've been testing it with gameplay videos from different indie developers, and the results have been pretty encouraging so far!

Still lots to improve, but it's coming along nicely! :)
